review.brief_reason: The rewrite is invalid under protected gplearn semantics. If t=log(x2), then the original protected composition log(sqrt(t)) activates when |t|>1e-6, whereas protected log(t)/2 activates only when |t|>0.001. Thus they produce different values in the common real-valued domain. The explicit fourth-root notation can also contract the real domain when its base is negative.
review.counterexample: Let x1=0 and x2=exp(0.0001). Then protected log(x2)=0.0001. The original inner term is log(sqrt(0.0001))=log(0.01)≈-4.605170186, while the proposed inner term is protected_log(0.0001)/2=0. Both fourth-root bases are nonnegative here, so both expressions are real, but their final values differ (approximately 0.846 versus 0.648).
